cards.ex: I felt obliged to donate to the charity after hearing their story.
cards.exUz: Ularning hikoyasini eshitgandan so'ng, men xayriya tashkilotiga xayriya qilishga majbur his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishga majbur ekanligini his qilish, ichki majburiyat.

cards.ex: You can invite friends over, within reason – no wild parties!
cards.exUz: Siz do'stlaringizni taklif qilishingiz mumkin, aql doirasida – hech qanday shovqinli bazmlar yo'q!
cards.uzDef: Oqilona va mumkin bo'lgan chegaralarda ruxsat etilgan.

cards.ex: Only authorized personnel are allowed in the server room.
cards.exUz: Faqat vakolatli xodimlarga server xonasiga kirishga ruxsat beriladi.
cards.uzDef: Rasman ruxsat etilgan yoki vakolat berilgan bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: As the manager, she gets to call the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Menejer sifatida u bu yerda buyruq berish huquqiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatda asosiy qarorlarni qabul qilish huquqiga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: You have the option to either accept the offer or decline it.
cards.exUz: Sizda taklifni qabul qilish yoki rad etish imkoniyati bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tanlash yoki qilmaslik imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Wearing a seatbelt is required by law in most countries.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda xavfsizlik kamarini taqish qonun talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qonunchilik tomonidan majburiy qilingan.

cards.ex: I'll leave it up to you to decide where we should eat.
cards.exUz: Qayerda ovqatlanishimizni siz hal qilishingizga ishonib topshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Qarorni yoki vazifani boshqa birovga ishonib topshirish.

cards.ex: The company will be held to account for its environmental damage.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya atrof-muhitga yetkazgan zarari uchun javobgarlikka tortiladi.
cards.uzDef: Xatti-harakatlari uchun javob berishga majbur qilish.

cards.ex: I felt under obligation to help my neighbor after his accident.
cards.exUz: Qo'shnim baxtsiz hodisadan keyin unga yordam berishga majbur ekanligimni his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy yoki axloqiy jihatdan biror narsani qilishga majbur.

cards.ex: Permission granted, you may proceed with the experiment.
cards.exUz: Ruxsat berildi, siz tajribani davom ettirishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishga ruxsat olish.

cards.ex: The rules permit students to use their phones during lunch break.
cards.exUz: Qoidalar talabalarga tushlik tanaffusida telefonlaridan foydalanishga ruxsat beradi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalar asosida biror narsani qilishga ruxsat bor.

cards.ex: Only I am authorized to access these files.
cards.exUz: Faqat menga ushbu fayllarga kirish vakolati berilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilish uchun rasmiy ruxsatga ega.

cards.ex: You can decorate your office at your discretion.
cards.exUz: Siz o'z ofisingizni o'z ixtiyoringiz bilan bezashingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z xohishiga ko'ra yoki o'z fikriga ko'ra hal qilish.

cards.ex: Students with disabilities may be exempt from certain tests.
cards.exUz: Nogiron talabalar ba'zi testlardan ozod qilinishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan ozod qilingan yoki majbur bo'lmagan.

cards.ex: If you want to keep your job, you need to toe the line.
cards.exUz: Agar siz ishingizni saqlab qolmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan qoidalarga yoki hokimiyatga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: I'm under orders to not let anyone through.
cards.exUz: Menga hech kimni o'tkazmaslik buyurilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir bo'ysunish majburiyatida bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Sorry, I have to go, duty calls!
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, men ketishim kerak, vazifa chaqiradi!
cards.uzDef: Majburiyatni bajarish vaqti keldi.

cards.ex: His opinion carries a lot of weight with the board of directors.
cards.exUz: Uning fikri direktorlar kengashida katta kuchga ega.
cards.uzDef: Muhim, ta'sirli yoki hurmatga sazovor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I felt duty-bound to report the incident to the police.
cards.exUz: Men voqeani politsiyaga xabar qilishga o'zimni burchli his qildim.
cards.uzDef: O'zini biror narsani qilishga axloqiy jihatdan majbur his qilish.

cards.ex: Attending the safety briefing is a mandatory requirement for all employees.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlik brifingida qatnashish barcha xodimlar uchun majburiy talabdir.
cards.uzDef: Bajarilishi shart bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The project is subject to approval from the board.
cards.exUz: Loyiha kengashdan tasdiqlanishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa amalga oshishi uchun ruxsat olish kerak.

cards.ex: The artist was given free rein to design the mural.
cards.exUz: Rassomga devoriy suratni yaratishda to'liq erkinlik berildi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday cheklovsiz erkinlikka ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Good attendance is required of all students.
cards.exUz: Barcha talabalardan yaxshi davomat talab qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kimdandir yoki biror narsadan talab qilinadigan narsa.

cards.ex: The rules dictate that you must wear a helmet while riding a bike.
cards.exUz: Qoidalar velosipedda haydash paytida dubulg'a kiyishingizni belgilaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalar bo'yicha shunday bo'lishi kerak.

cards.ex: We are bound by law to protect your personal information.
cards.exUz: Biz qonun bilan sizning shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni himoya qilishga majburmiz.
cards.uzDef: Qonun tomonidan majburiy qilingan.

cards.ex: Safety takes precedence over everything else on this site.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlik bu saytda hamma narsadan ustunlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga qaraganda muhimroq yoki birinchi o'rinda bo'lish.

cards.ex: You are liable for any damage you cause to the property.
cards.exUz: Siz mulkka yetkazgan har qanday zarar uchun javobgarsiz.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy ravishda javobgar bo'lish.

cards.ex: The sign read 'Authorized personnel only beyond this point'.
cards.exUz: Belgida 'Bu nuqtadan keyin faqat vakolatli xodimlar' deb yozilgan.
cards.uzDef: Faqat ruxsat etilgan odamlarga kirishga ruxsat etiladi.

cards.ex: He was given leave to attend the conference.
cards.exUz: Unga konferensiyada qatnashishga ruxsat berildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishga ruxsat olish.

cards.ex: I have no say in where we go on vacation.
cards.exUz: Biz qayerga ta'tilga borishimiz haqida hech qanday fikrim yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishda ishtirok etish huquqiga ega emaslik.
